name: software-estimation-skills
description: Three Claude skills that estimate what custom software costs to build: sourced market rates, a first-principles bottom-up estimate, and a per-task AI savings pass.

plugins.name: software-market-rates
plugins.description: Builds a sourced, dated table of software developer rates by role, seniority and country, and a blended rate for a proposed team.

plugins.name: software-cost-estimate
plugins.description: Turns a requirements document into a first-principles, bottom-up software cost estimate: work items, days per discipline, capacity check and a formula-driven spreadsheet.

plugins.name: ai-savings-pass
plugins.description: Applies a per-task AI savings pass to a software estimate: splits items into activities, scores how delegable each one is, and returns the total without AI and with AI.
